all_findings.evidence: Modal fires on page load covering the rink tap area entirely. A parent mid-game who reloads or navigates away loses the ability to log shots until they dismiss the modal. 'Got it' button is only dismissal path.

all_findings.evidence: Changelog describes 'End Game button' in persistent row, but no confirmation dialog or guard is visible or described. Accidental tap of End Game would save and archive an incomplete game with no undo path described.
all_findings.fix_hint: Require a 2-step confirmation ('End Game?' → 'Yes, end') before triggering the End Game flow to prevent accidental game termination.

all_findings.evidence: Legend row '● GOAL ● HOME SHOT ● AWAY SHOT ○ MISS' is at the very bottom of the screen in small text. In a rink environment (low light, cold hands) this is easily missed and requires recall of color meanings during live play.
all_findings.fix_hint: Increase legend font size and contrast. Consider placing shot-type labels adjacent to the tap targets or use a persistent color key near the rink, not at the screen edge.

all_findings.evidence: The 'WHAT'S NEW IN V3.0' modal occupies roughly 70% of the visible viewport with dense paragraph text about 8+ new features, completely replacing the rink UI for an active-game user.
all_findings.fix_hint: Move release notes to a dedicated Settings or About screen. If shown at all post-update, use a compact toast or badge notification, not a full-screen modal.
